name: petroleum-reservoir-paper-team
description: An eight-member expert team for petroleum reservoir engineering academic paper writing, covering topic selection, research, writing, review and formatting.

displayName.zh: 石油工程油藏论文写作专家团

profession.zh: 石油工程油藏论文写作专家团

displayDescription.en: An eight-member team for petroleum reservoir engineering academic papers, covering topic selection, research, writing, review and formatting end-to-end.
displayDescription.zh: 聚焦石油工程油藏方向，八位专家分工协作，从选题、调研、写作到审稿排版，全流程支撑高质量学术论文产出。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我选题：基于深度学习压裂停泵压力去噪方向，推荐3个有创新性的论文选题，并说明每个选题的选题意义、创新点和可检索的数据库。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me choose a topic: based on deep learning denoising of fracture pump-stop pressure data, recommend 3 innovative paper topics with significance, novelty and searchable databases.

quickPrompts.en: Help me choose a topic: based on deep learning denoising of fracture pump-stop pressure data, recommend 3 innovative paper topics with significance, novelty and searchable databases.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我选题：基于深度学习压裂停泵压力去噪方向，推荐3个有创新性的论文选题，并说明每个选题的选题意义、创新点和可检索的数据库。

quickPrompts.en: Organize my research notes and generate a structured outline for a petroleum reservoir engineering paper.
quickPrompts.zh: 整理我的研究笔记，生成一份石油工程油藏方向论文大纲，包含标题、摘要、关键词、引言、方法、结果与讨论、结论。

quickPrompts.en: Review this reservoir engineering paper draft and give revision suggestions according to core journal standards.
quickPrompts.zh: 审阅这篇油藏工程论文初稿，按中文核心期刊和SCI/EI标准给出修改意见，包括创新性、数据合理性、结论合理性和应用价值。
